On 2026-10-05 the Owner answered "บืนยันขั้น 2" to step 2 item 1, "Apply RFC-024's cross-vendor exception to all 15 work packages", and WP-0A-CON-007 is one of those 15 (evidence/WP-0A-A0-001/product-owner-disposition-2026-10-05-g0-step2.md §3 row 1). That history is why each of this package's role files says so. What remains is all of CONTRIBUTING_AGENTS.md § Separation of duties: four distinct agent_run_ids in the four roles, plus the conditional Security reviewer; no run approves, test-verifies, integrates or gate-approves its own work; a distinct same-vendor run in a named role IS that role's signature; and every role file opens with the §0 spawning disclosure (RFC-2026-024 §3/3-4). G0's external verification is unchanged and nothing an agent here can do satisfies it (RFC-2026-024 §3/5).

purpose: CTR-EVT-001 shipped metadata.schema_ref as an unconstrained string, and it accepted all sixteen hostile forms probed against it -- file:///etc/passwd, javascript:, a data: URI, a protocol-relative //host, traversal, a cloud instance-metadata address and a 100000-character value -- on the envelope that carries every event in the system. Separately, no reference field anywhere in the catalog carried an upper bound: an allow-list pattern says what a value may look like, not how much of it there may be.

include: A contract-name constraint on CTR-EVT-001 metadata.schema_ref, with an upper bound
An upper bound on every reference field in the A0-owned contracts
A behaviour test standing guard over both, modelled on the CTR-JOB-001 reference-hardening suite
RFC-2026-009 recording why schema_ref needed a DIFFERENT constraint rather than a tightened one
exclude: CTR-NTF-001 deep_link.target_ref: the contract belongs to A5, and proposing a change to it is reserved to A5
Any change to the catalog's `scheme:path` reference pattern itself
Any provider integration or non-synthetic data

authorized_cross_package_amendments: test-kits/integrity-manifest.json (WP-0A-A0-002 output; that package is in_review) - permitted change: update exactly two digests, test-kits/contracts/ctr-evt-001-schema-ref-bounds.test.mjs and architecture/decisions/RFC-2026-009-reference-bounds.md, to match their 2026-10-06 bytes. Both files are this package's own. The edit is not discretionary: scripts/verify-test-coverage-floor.mjs exits 86 when a digested file's bytes move, and the manifest's cross_package_note says any package that changes a digested file must update it. npm run regenerate:manifest rebuilt 91 digests and exactly those two entries changed. Acknowledgement runs to WP-0A-A0-002's Integration Owner, /claude/r0_steward.

acceptance_criteria: metadata.schema_ref rejects every one of the sixteen hostile forms that the shipped schema accepted, and the probe is recorded as having been run against the schema BEFORE the fix.
metadata.schema_ref still accepts a well-formed contract name, so the guard is not one that rejects everything.
A value that satisfies the contract-name shape and exceeds the bound is rejected, so the bound is tested independently of the shape.
Every reference field this package touches carries a maxLength.
The guard asserts behaviour, never pattern text.
npm run check stays green with no test skipped, and no declared unkilled ceiling rises.
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert through a reviewed revert PR. Constraints on four Candidate contracts and one test file; no persisted data, provider state, credential, migration or customer-data effect.
open_blockers: RESOLVED 2026-10-06 (was: "RFC-2026-009 is Proposed and requires Product Owner disposition before the RFC-2026-002 manual merge."). RFC-2026-009 carries the Product Owner disposition of 2026-09-02, commit 82aae60, on its status line (A1 condition 8, C0 §5). What is still open is the sequencing, in required_human_authorities[0], for the Integration Owner.

CTR-NTF-001 deep_link.target_ref remains unbounded. It belongs to A5 (contract owner) through WP-0A-CON-006, and it is reported, not fixed. Since 2026-10-06 it and its three unbounded neighbours (notification_id, message_key, dedupe_key) are in the guard's KNOWN_UNBOUNDED list, so they are visible, and the list fails when the owner bounds them until the entry is removed.

RESOLVED 2026-10-06 (was: "The 256-character bound is a DECLARED INFERENCE. The longest reference in the catalog is 51 characters; no baseline task states a limit. A reviewer who knows the real ceiling should set it."). The figure was wrong: the longest is 85 (ctr-usg-001 dedupe_key, valid fixture), or 48 counting *_ref only (A1 S-8, C0 F6). No baseline document states a limit. The bounds are now recorded as A0's decision as owner of the four contracts, under the Owner's 2026-09-28 instruction to carry out the work as A0 recommends (RFC-2026-009 R-2). 256 is load-bearing in migrations 050, 110 and 140 as length(...) <= 256 CHECK constraints, so a change in either direction needs a forward migration in the same change. A1's suggestion to lower schema_ref to 24 is recorded, not taken; it is CTR-EVT-001's owner's before freeze.
